extDescription.message: Show YouTube Shorts dates and hide videos, Shorts and comments from unwanted channels.

featShortsDateHint.message: The date appears to the left of each Short.

featUserBlockHint.message: Block beside Subscribe or in the comment action row. Hide their videos, Shorts and comments.

blockEmpty.message: No blocked users. Use Block beside a YouTube comment author.

blockLocalHint.message: Saved in this browser only. Unblock to show hidden items again.

blockButtonHint.message: Hide this user's videos, Shorts and comments

blockConfirm.message: Hide videos, Shorts and comments from $NAME$ in this browser? You can unblock them in the extension popup.

blockSaveError.message: Could not save. Please try again.

blockLoadError.message: Could not load blocked users. Reopen the extension popup.

blockedPlayback.message: This channel is blocked. Move to another video or unblock it in the KarmoLab popup.

featBase64Hint.message: Show destination links; expand the arrow to view the source. Reads enabled sites locally, without sending text anywhere.

base64Unsupported.message: Open a regular webpage. Browser settings and extension stores are not supported.

base64Denied.message: Site access was not granted. You can try enabling it again later.

base64Error.message: Could not apply this site setting. Refresh the page and try again.

featShortsCountHint.message: Videos count after 2 seconds. Watch time includes visible playback and automatic loops. Resets at local midnight; saved only in this browser.

panelTranslationHint.message: Comments set to Show original stay unchanged

panelSaveError.message: Could not save. Please try again.

commentDensityHint.message: Time, author and text on one line without avatars. Actions appear on hover or keyboard focus.

homeDensityHint.message: Resize regular video cards on Home, keeping title text size and thumbnail proportions.

undoChanged.message: This block changed afterward. Check the management panel.

undoFailed.message: Could not undo the block. Try again.

backupHeading.message: Back up and restore YouTube settings

backupHint.message: Save stored YouTube settings, keywords and blocked users as JSON. Viewing history, site permissions and volume are excluded.

backupRestore.message: Restore settings and merge blocked users

backupPreview.message: $SETTINGS$ settings, $BLOCKS$ blocked users. Keep existing blocks and use the backed-up settings.

backupInvalid.message: Select a valid KarmoLab YouTube JSON backup under 1 MB.

backupExported.message: Download requested. Check your browser's downloads.

backupExportError.message: Could not create the backup. Check your settings and try again.

backupRestored.message: Backup restored. Existing blocked users kept.

backupRestoredDraft.message: Backup restored. Unsaved keyword input was kept.

backupRestoreError.message: Restore failed. Applied values were rolled back. Try again.

backupPartialError.message: Restore and rollback failed. Reload your settings and check them.

commentTranslateHint.message: Automatically clicks Translate to Korean for comments and replies. Show original stays selected. Turning this off stops new translations.

commentTranslateError.message: Could not read or save the automatic translation setting.

reviewHint.message: Review and restore hidden items in YouTube's KarmoLab settings

reviewUnavailable.message: Recovery information is unavailable. Reload this page.

keywordSaved.message: Saved. Open YouTube pages update immediately.

keywordError.message: Could not read or save settings. Use up to 200 keywords, each at most 200 characters.

homeCardWidthHint.message: Smaller widths show more videos per row. Columns adapt to the available screen width.

volumeHint.message: 0-300%. Video/audio volume up to 100% restores on future visits. Above 100% needs one activation per new tab. Audio is never recorded or uploaded.

volumeUnsupported.message: Open the popup on a regular webpage.

volumeDenied.message: Site or audio permission was not granted.

volumeError.message: Could not apply volume. Reopen the popup on this tab and try again.
